title: Bears TE Colston Loveland carted off with knee injury against Lions

title: Thanksgiving storm damages buildings, floods streets, causes power outages
summary: Strong winds ripped the roof off a building in Maryland, as an extreme storm began to move up the East Coast on Thanksgiving morning.
